fullPassage: The concept of ecosystem states should be familiar to anyone with a home vegetable garden. The garden is a small ecosystem that the grower attempts to keep in a specific state, namely the maximization of fruit and vegetable production. To achieve this, the grower is almost always intervening in the dynamics of the ecosystem; they remove unwanted plants that begin to grow and perhaps spray insecticides and fence off the patch to stop insects and other animals from consuming the vegetables. Since maximizing vegetable growth is an inherently unstable state for the ecosystem, the grower is effectively keeping the ball on a slope. If the grower stops intervening, even for a day, the ecosystem, that small patch of ground, will naturally begin to shift to a more stable state. Vegetables may still grow, but yield will almost certainly be lower as other plants crowd out the vegetables and wildlife consume the produce.

questions.passage: The concept of ecosystem states should be familiar to anyone with a home vegetable garden. The garden is a small ecosystem that the grower (A)[attempts / refuses] to keep in a specific state, namely the (B)[maximization / minimization] of fruit and vegetable production. To achieve this, the grower is almost always (C)[intervening / withdrawing] in the dynamics of the ecosystem. Since maximizing vegetable growth is an inherently unstable state for the ecosystem, the grower is effectively keeping the ball on a slope. If the grower stops intervening, even for a day, the ecosystem, that small patch of ground, will naturally begin to shift to a more stable state. Vegetables may still grow, but yield will almost certainly be lower as other plants crowd out the vegetables and wildlife consume the produce.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 정원은 재배자가 특정 상태로 유지하려 시도하는(attempts) 작은 생태계이며, 과일과 채소 생산의 극대화(maximization)를 목표로 한다. 이를 위해 재배자는 거의 항상 생태계의 역학에 개입(intervening)한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① attempts — maximization — intervening: 원문과 일치
❌ ② refuses(거부하다): attempts의 반의어
❌ ③ minimization(최소화): maximization의 반의어
❌ ④ withdrawing(철수하다): intervening의 반의어
det.tip: attempt = 시도하다, maximization = 극대화, intervene = 개입하다

questions.passage: They remove (A)[unwanted / desired] plants that begin to grow and perhaps spray insecticides and fence off the patch to (B)[stop / encourage] insects and other animals from (C)[consuming / cultivating] the vegetables.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 그들은 자라기 시작하는 원치 않는(unwanted) 식물을 제거하고, 곤충과 동물이 채소를 먹는 것(consuming)을 막기 위해(stop) 살충제를 뿌리고 울타리를 친다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ unwanted — stop — consuming: 원문과 일치
❌ ① desired(바라는): unwanted의 반의어
❌ ② encourage(장려하다): stop의 반의어
❌ ④ cultivating(재배하다): consuming의 반의어
det.tip: unwanted = 원치 않는, stop A from B = A가 B하는 것을 막다, consume = 소비하다/먹다

questions.passage: The garden is a small ecosystem that the grower attempts to keep in a specific state, namely the maximization of fruit and vegetable production. To achieve this, the grower is almost always intervening in the dynamics of the ecosystem; they remove unwanted plants that begin to grow and perhaps spray insecticides and fence off the patch to stop insects and other animals from consuming the vegetables. Since maximizing vegetable growth is an inherently (A)[unstable / stable] state for the ecosystem, the grower is effectively keeping the ball on a slope. If the grower stops intervening, the ecosystem will naturally begin to (B)[shift / remain] to a more (C)[stable / chaotic] state. Vegetables may still grow, but yield will almost certainly be lower as other plants crowd out the vegetables and wildlife consume the produce.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 채소 성장 극대화는 본질적으로 불안정한(unstable) 상태이다. 재배자가 개입을 멈추면 생태계는 자연히 더 안정적인(stable) 상태로 전환(shift)되기 시작한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② unstable — shift — stable: 원문과 일치
❌ ① stable(안정적인): unstable의 반의어
❌ ③ remain(유지되다): shift의 반의어
❌ ④ chaotic(혼란스러운): stable의 반의어
det.tip: unstable = 불안정한, shift = 전환하다/이동하다, stable = 안정적인

questions.passage: The garden is a small ecosystem that the grower attempts to keep in a ①<u>specific</u> state, namely the maximization of fruit and vegetable ②<u>production</u>. To achieve this, the grower is almost always ③<u>intervening</u> in the dynamics of the ecosystem; they ④<u>preserve</u> unwanted plants that begin to grow.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ preserve(보존하다) → remove(제거하다): 원치 않는 식물은 '제거'하는 것이므로 preserve는 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① specific(특정한): 원문 일치
✅ ② production(생산): 원문 일치
✅ ③ intervening(개입하는): 원문 일치
❌ ④ preserve(보존하다): 원문은 remove(제거하다) — 반의어로 교체됨
det.tip: remove(제거하다) ↔ preserve(보존하다)

questions.passage: Since maximizing vegetable growth is an inherently unstable state for the ecosystem, the grower is effectively keeping the ball on a slope. If the grower stops intervening, even for a day, the ecosystem, that small patch of ground, will naturally begin to shift to a more stable state. Vegetables may still grow, but ①<u>yield</u> will almost certainly be ②<u>higher</u> as other plants ③<u>crowd out</u> the vegetables and ④<u>wildlife</u> consume the produce.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② higher(더 높은) → lower(더 낮은): 다른 식물이 채소를 밀어내면 수확량이 '낮아지는' 것이므로 higher는 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① yield(수확량): 원문 일치
❌ ② higher(더 높은): 원문은 lower(더 낮은) — 반의어로 교체됨
✅ ③ crowd out(밀어내다): 원문 일치
✅ ④ wildlife(야생동물): 원문 일치
det.tip: lower(더 낮은) ↔ higher(더 높은), crowd out = 밀어내다

questions.passage: The concept of ecosystem states should be ①<u>familiar</u> to anyone with a home vegetable garden. Since maximizing vegetable growth is an inherently ②<u>unstable</u> state for the ecosystem, the grower is effectively keeping the ball on a slope. If the grower stops intervening, the ecosystem will naturally begin to ③<u>resist</u> to a more stable state. Vegetables may still grow, but yield will almost certainly be ④<u>lower</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ resist(저항하다) → shift(전환하다): 생태계가 더 안정적인 상태로 '전환'되기 시작하는 맥락이므로 resist는 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① familiar(익숙한): 원문 일치
✅ ② unstable(불안정한): 원문 일치
❌ ③ resist(저항하다): 원문은 shift(전환하다) — 다른 단어로 교체됨
✅ ④ lower(더 낮은): 원문 일치
det.tip: shift to = ~로 전환하다 | resist = 저항하다 — 방향성이 완전히 다름

❌ ④ watering(물 주는): 동물이 채소에 물을 주는 것이 아님
det.tip: consume = 먹다, 소비하다 | stop A from consuming B = A가 B를 먹는 것을 막다

questions.passage: To achieve this, the grower is almost always intervening in the dynamics of the ecosystem; they remove unwanted plants that begin to grow and perhaps spray insecticides and fence off the patch to stop insects and other animals from consuming the vegetables. Since maximizing vegetable growth is an inherently unstable state for the ecosystem, the grower is effectively keeping the ball on a slope. If the grower stops intervening, even for a day, the ecosystem, that small patch of ground, will naturally begin to shift to a more stable state. Vegetables may still grow, but yield will almost certainly be lower as other plants crowd out the vegetables and wildlife consume the produce.
questions.stem:
"다른 식물들이 채소를 밀어내다"를 영어로 옮길 때 빈칸에 가장 적절한 것은?

other plants __________ the vegetables

det.korean: 채소를 밀어내다 = crowd out the vegetables
det.analysis:
✅ ① crowd out(밀어내다): 원문 일치 — 다른 식물이 공간을 차지하여 밀어냄
❌ ② bring up(기르다): 양육의 의미
❌ ③ look after(돌보다): 보살피는 의미
❌ ④ give away(나눠주다): 무관한 의미
det.tip: crowd out = 밀어내다, 내쫓다 | 다른 식물이 공간/자원을 빼앗아 밀어내는 것
